items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: he was much more powerful than this Buddy PT. You know, he could blow louder and everything. But for knowing his instrument, I think Buddy was, yeah.

ctx.x: Did Chris have more variations or less?

Well, he was much, I mean, he was much more powerful than this Buddy PT. You know, he could blow louder and everything. But for knowing his instrument, I think Buddy was, yeah. What about Kid Rene? Did you hear him when you... Yeah, Kid Rene was another guy in his time, could do a lot of playing too, but he wasn't, he was louder than Buddy. Because all of them came up just about that same time, Kid Rene, Buddy PT, Lois Armstrong, Joe Oliver was just before that time. Because Joe Oliver, I don't know when he left…

Did you ever know Blond Freddy, a clarinet player by that name? Blond Freddy, no. Did you ever know Isidore Fritz, who's from out in the country somewhere? Isidore Fritz, huh? I just wondered how those fellas played, and we don't have any records of them. Blond Freddy's still alive, but he doesn't play clarinet. No, no, I don't know them. Who does Jack Carey play like on one of the other ones?
